people.name: Galatia
people.line: A region in Asia Minor, recipient of Paul's epistle.

translations.web: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
translations.bsb: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
translations.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
translations.asv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I gave order to the churches of Galatia, so also do ye.
